Title: Successfully onboard a new vendor with valid details
Preconditions: The user is logged into the system with administrative privileges and has access to the Vendor Onboarding module.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the Vendor Onboarding page
2. Enter valid vendor details including Vendor Name, select a Work Category, and assign an existing Site
3. Click the 'Submit' or 'Onboard Vendor' button
Expected Result: The vendor is successfully created and saved in the system, and a success message is displayed showing the new vendor's details.

Title: Verify successful definition of a plan of action for a vendor assignment
Preconditions: The user is logged in as a company admin and an active vendor assignment exists in the system.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the vendor assignment details page.
2. Click on the 'Define Plan of Action' button.
3. Enter a valid value for estimated work days (e.g., 10).
4. Enter a valid value for estimated per-day costs (e.g., 150.00).
5. Click the 'Save' button.
Expected Result: The plan of action is successfully saved and associated with the vendor assignment, displaying the correct estimated work days and per-day costs in the system.

Title: Successful Submission of Actual Daily Expenses and Duration by Vendor
Preconditions: The vendor is logged into the vendor portal, has an assigned work order, and is on the expense and duration submission page.
Steps:
1. Enter valid numeric values for actual daily expenses in the designated expense fields.
2. Enter a valid positive integer for the actual number of days taken to complete the work.
3. Click the 'Submit' button.
Expected Result: The system successfully validates and saves the submitted actual expenses and duration, displays a success confirmation message, and updates the work order status to reflect that actuals have been submitted.

Title: Verify automatic calculation of expense and completion time variances for an assignment
Preconditions: The user is logged in, and an assignment exists with a defined estimated expense of $500, a planned completion time of 10 days, an actual expense of $600, and an actual completion time of 12 days.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the assignments management module.
2. Select the specific assignment to view its details.
3. Review the calculated variance fields for expenses and completion time.
Expected Result: The system automatically calculates and displays an expense variance of -$100 (or $100 over budget) and a completion time variance of -2 days (or 2 days delayed) for the assignment.

Title: Verify vendor assignment classification based on cost and time variance thresholds
Preconditions: The user is logged in with admin or QA privileges, and variance thresholds for cost and time are configured in the system settings.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the Vendor Management module and select a vendor assignment.
2. Input actual cost and completion time values that exceed the defined 'Red' variance threshold.
3. Save the assignment details and observe the assigned flag status.
4. Repeat the process with values falling within the 'At Risk' and 'Green' variance thresholds respectively.
Expected Result: The system correctly classifies and displays the vendor assignment flag status as 'Red' when variances exceed the critical threshold, 'At Risk' for moderate variances, and 'Green' when variances are within acceptable limits.

Title: Verify Vendor Performance Dashboard filtering by site, work category, and flag status
Preconditions: User is logged in with appropriate permissions, and the system contains vendor assignments across multiple sites, work categories, and flag statuses.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the Vendor Performance Dashboard.
2. Select a specific site from the site filter dropdown.
3. Select a specific work category from the work category filter dropdown.
4. Select a specific flag status (e.g., 'Underperforming' or 'Optimal') from the flag status filter dropdown.
5. Verify that the displayed vendor assignments list updates to match all applied filter criteria.
Expected Result: The dashboard successfully displays only the vendor assignments that match the selected site, work category, and flag status filters, allowing accurate identification of optimal or underperforming vendors.

Title: Verify historical record and evaluation of vendor flag outcomes across past assignments
Preconditions: The vendor has completed at least two past assignments with recorded flag outcomes (e.g., one positive and one negative flag), and the user is logged in with permissions to view vendor evaluation data.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the Vendor Management module and select an existing vendor with past assignment history.
2. Access the vendor's profile and open the 'Historical Records' or 'Flag Outcomes' tab.
3. Review the listed flag outcomes from all past assignments to ensure completeness and accuracy.
4. Initiate the process of awarding a new work assignment to the vendor and review the displayed reliability evaluation based on the historical flag data.
Expected Result: The system accurately displays a complete historical record of all past flag outcomes for the vendor, and this historical data is correctly factored into the reliability evaluation presented to the user before awarding future work.

Title: Verify authorized user can export vendor performance data as CSV for a specific site and quarter
Preconditions: User is authenticated with a role authorized for data export, and vendor performance data exists for the selected site and quarter.
Steps:
1. Navigate to the Vendor Performance dashboard
2. Select a specific site and quarter from the filter options
3. Click the 'Export to CSV' button
Expected Result: The system successfully generates and downloads a CSV file containing the correct vendor performance data filtered by the selected site and quarter.
